B. Tax instalments for the year ending October 31, 2027

The CRA wants the corporation to pay its tax a little every three months, not all at once after the year ends. These payments are called instalments.

Last year, the corporation was open for only 6 months. Stretched to a full year, its tax comes to more than $3,000. When that happens, the CRA asks for these payments the next year.

These payments are not extra tax. They count toward the corporation's tax for the year ending October 31, 2027. If you skip them, the CRA charges interest.

Instalment due dates

  • January 31, 2027: $500
  • April 30, 2027: $500
  • July 31, 2027: $500

Pay instalments to the same RC 0001 account and choose "instalment" as the payment type.

C. How to pay

Pay through your online banking or through CRA My Payment on the CRA website. Each amount above is its own payment.

D. Your documents

Your compiled financial statements, full T2 return, signed T183CORP, CRA e-file confirmation and minute book letter (please forward it to your lawyer) are in your TaxDome portal. The CRA requires you to keep them for 6 years.
